author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Peace talks between the US and Iran have stalled over uranium enrichment curbs, with Washington proposing a 20-year freeze and Tehran offering five years. Disagreements also arose regarding the scope of a potential deal, including Hormuz and sanctions relief, despite initial hopes for a breakthrough.
title: 20-yr pause of uranium enrichment & Tehran's counter: How US–Iran talks collapsed at the last mile

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Riyan Parag termed Rajasthan Royals’ heavy loss to Sunrisers Hyderabad a “blip” after a dramatic top-order collapse. He credited SRH’s debutant pacers for their impact, reflected on tactical decisions, and praised his team’s fightback after being 9/5. Parag remained optimistic, backing RR to recover quickly and perform better in their next match.
title: ‘To be honest…’: Riyan Parag breaks silence after heavy defeat to SRH

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Intel's stock experienced a significant surge, gaining over $100 billion in market capitalization within ten days, driven by a $14.2 billion plant buyback and partnerships with Tesla and Google. Despite this rally, Wall Street remains cautious, with a majority of analysts recommending holding or selling the stock.

description: Iran's consulate in Mumbai pushed back on US President Donald Trump's claims of its navy being "finished." Showcasing fast missile boats and referencing a Shah Rukh Khan movie dialogue, Iran warned the US that "the movie is still left," asserting their defense systems remain operational and control over the Strait of Hormuz.

Undercover operations led to arrests of seven employees amid allegations of sexual exploitation, religious coercion, and workplace harassment. TCS has suspended employees and launched an internal probe.

description: Tech pioneer George Hotz dismisses panic over Anthropic's AI model Mythos, claiming he could find zero-days faster. He argues skilled hackers have better, legal options, making exploits rare due to incentives, not difficulty. Experts agree, noting Mythos's findings were in controlled environments. Smaller, cheaper AI models also demonstrated similar capabilities, questioning the 'watershed moment' claim.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Former US President Donald Trump faced backlash for an AI image showing him as a Jesus-like figure. He later explained it was meant to portray him as a doctor healing people. The image, which sparked criticism from supporters and others, was eventually deleted. Trump dismissed the negative reactions as fake news.

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is making waves in IPL 2026 with explosive batting. Former pacer Simon Doull warns the young star about management companies prioritizing profit over his long-term career. Doull advises Sooryavanshi to be cautious of external influences and surround himself with people who genuinely care about his development and longevity.
title: ‘Watch out for sharks’: Sooryavanshi gets warning after golden duck

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Following recent unrest, the Uttar Pradesh government has approved a significant increase in minimum wages for all worker categories, implemented retrospectively from April 1. This decision, approved by the CM, aims to address demands for higher pay and better conditions after large-scale factory worker protests.
title: UP govt hikes minimum wages after Noida protests; revised rates effective from April 1

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has addressed the women of India, emphasizing "Nari Shakti" and the government's commitment to women's reservation in legislative bodies. He highlighted the upcoming special Parliament session to pass a constitutional amendment for the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, aiming for its full implementation by the 2029 elections.
title: 'Will be gross injustice if delayed': PM Modi urges support for women’s reservation bill

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have reignited interest in antique diamonds, shifting focus from flawless, mass-produced stones to rare, character-rich pieces. Their engagement spotlighted vintage craftsmanship, sustainability, and uniqueness. Jewellers report rising demand, though high-quality antique diamonds remain scarce and costly. As buyers seek meaning over perfection, these historic stones are becoming prized choices, blending romance, heritage, and individuality in modern engagement trends.

title: Will MS Dhoni play today against KKR? Latest update on CSK keeper's return

author: FAIZ RAHMAN SIDDIQUI
description: Kanpur police have arrested Rohit Tewari, a Class XII passout, for managing 30 illegal kidney transplants by posing as a doctor. The racket, exposed on March 31, involved luring poor individuals to sell kidneys and selling them to wealthy patients for exorbitant prices. Tewari, who was on the run, has been identified as the mastermind behind the operation.
title: 12th pass ‘doctor’ held after 30 illegal kidney transplants; poor lured for Rs 5L, organs sold for Rs 1 cr

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Oil prices dipped below $100 per barrel as hopes for eased US-Iran dialogue emerged following peace talks in Islamabad. Despite some positive signs, an agreement was not reached, with Iran refusing to abandon nuclear fuel enrichment. The US military extended its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, prompting threats from Iran, though diplomatic channels remain open.
title: Oil prices fall below $100 as US–Iran signal fresh talks amid Hormuz blockade

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Meta is reportedly developing an AI-powered version of CEO Mark Zuckerberg to interact with employees, trained on his mannerisms and public statements. Zuckerberg is personally involved in its development, dedicating significant time to AI projects. This initiative is part of Meta's substantial AI investment aimed at competing with rivals and enhancing its products and operations.
title: Meta needs more than one Mark Zuckerberg: Company is building an AI-powered version of its CEO

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu declared the nation has fulfilled its promise to prevent a second Holocaust, citing military actions against Iranian nuclear sites. He also criticized Europe's "deep moral weakness" and loss of identity. President Herzog urged global leaders to combat rising antisemitism, emphasizing national unity amidst ongoing challenges.

description: Opposition leader Suvendu Adhikari warned Muslim migrant workers in Nandigram that they might lose work in BJP-governed states after the assembly polls. He cited the presence of thousands of workers in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Odisha, all ruled by the BJP. The TMC criticized Adhikari's remarks as threats and intimidation, vowing to report the matter to the Election Commission.

description: A major hotel booking website has confirmed a hacking attack, with hackers potentially accessing customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, and booking details. Users are reporting phishing attempts following the breach.

description: A school in Hungary, inspired by B.R. Ambedkar, serves as a beacon for the Roma community, mirroring their struggles with oppression. description: El Niño years since 1980 have frequently coincided with poor Indian summer monsoons, with around 70% experiencing deficient or below-normal rainfall. description: Blue Origin has successfully extracted oxygen from Moon-like soil in lab tests, a significant step for sustained lunar presence. This molten regolith electrolysis technique could drastically cut reliance on Earth supplies. The process, which also yields useful metals for construction, addresses a key challenge for future long-term human missions beyond our planet.
title: Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin extracts oxygen from Moon dust in major breakthrough
